target_layout.evidence: ghidra_get_struct_layout(FixedPoolAllocator) reports size 32 and field_18 at offset 0x18.

mechanics.null_path: The body has no null guard and dereferences the first stack word.
mechanics.decrement: Read the allocator pointer, decrement the signed 32-bit word at offset 0x18, and retain the post-decrement value in ESI.
mechanics.release_call: Pass the same allocator pointer to LeaveCriticalSection after the decrement, then return the retained post-decrement value in EAX.
mechanics.underflow: There is no clamp or branch in the body; the model preserves 32-bit wraparound when the signed count is INT32_MIN.

evidence.observation: Ghidra reports FixedPoolAllocator::Free with body range 0x00926140-0x00926155 and 9 instructions.
The body loads the first stack word, decrements [EAX+0x18], reads the result into ESI, calls LeaveCriticalSection with EAX, and returns ESI.
Ghidra reports one direct caller at 0x00927a50.
The sole direct call xref is 0x00927bb7.
The only direct callee is LeaveCriticalSection.
The imported structure exposes the accessed field at offset 0x18.

confidence.overall: high for decrement, release order, return value, and absence of a null guard
medium: whether the imported Free label denotes destruction, release, or another allocator boundary

unresolved_questions: The imported Free label and source-level allocator ownership semantics are not independently established.
The concrete critical-section object and runtime caller pairing remain opaque.
The later 0x00926340 call in the teardown caller is outside this function.
